segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! November is Black Friday, plus Thank U, Next. This month starts with gratitude and ends with the best long-plan prices of the year. First we say thank you. Then we say, sincerely, have you seen this annual?

segments.title: ₹11.23L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Kenkere House is 11.2 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent more than last November. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 5.95 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.82 lakh, everything else 78,600, and comebacks 67,400. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 57 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 847 leads, 305 trials, and 57 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.

Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 3.79 lakh rupees, which is 34 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Thank U, Next (Year)
segments.text: First up, Thank U, Next Year. Appreciation week. A guest pass to share, a members-only night, and a gift for anyone who's hit a hundred classes. No catch. Just gratitude, and glutes. The plan is 3 buyers at about 12,400, so 37,200 rupees.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: Next, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. If the recipient loves it, half comes off their first month. The plan is 12 buyers at about 1,500, so 18,000 rupees.

segments.title: Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday
segments.text: And finally, the big one, Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday. Four days of the year's best long-plan prices, plus the last Club Nine seats. No one-month discounts. We're not that kind of studio. The plan is 6 buyers at about 54,000, so 3.24 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, appreciation week, with guest passes and hundred-class gifts. Week two, Secret Santa vouchers reach every office and group chat. Week three, members get the Black Friday dates first. Week four, four days of Black Friday, long plans only.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Kenkere House. 11.2 lakh rupees, three offers, and 57 buyers to welcome. Grateful, gorgeous, and fully booked. That's November.
